name: agent-loading
title: Loading
description: What shows while an agent works: a live mark, a shimmering label and the time so far.

TetrisStill.description: The tetris mark at rest, every dot filled: the finished header's mark.

TetrisLabel.description: The label beside the mark: a shimmer, and on top a copy of the text the band crosses after the mark, on the same loop, so the light runs from the icon on through the word.

ShimmerLabel.description: The label shimmer alone (a band of ink passing through muted text), for the flappy header.

FlappySprite.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: label
props.description: The live label. Defaults to the `thinking` label ("Thinking…").

props.name: time
props.description: Elapsed time after the label, e.g. "1.2s".

props.name: glimmer
props.description: The light that crosses the tetris mark and its label as rows clear: glimm's prism, or neutral.
